placements.why: Establishes the strata category for system recovery strategies, operational resilience, and verification procedures.
placements.title: System reliability and recovery mechanisms require active verification
placements.frame: How are operational recovery procedures and fault tolerance mechanisms verified and maintained?

placements.title: Recovery mechanisms are non-existent until verified through routine rehearsal
placements.frame: Does the expression treat operational recovery procedures as purely theoretical until proven through scheduled rehearsal?
placements.why: src-1 mandates a monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollbacks, while src-2 grounds this directive in the principle that an unrehearsed rollback cannot be considered an actual capability.
